# Website Redesign v3 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A calmer, more editorial and easier-to-use Nest & Rest website, with flatter components, photo-led services, a clear price explanation and an accessible mobile menu. Business facts and booking logic stay exactly as they are.

**Architecture:** Static site generated by `tools/build.mjs` from `js/config.js`, with shared styles in `css/site.css` and behaviour in `js/site.js`. v3 changes tokens and components in the CSS, recomposes the homepage and pricing sections in the build script, and makes one behaviour fix (mobile-menu focus) in `js/site.js`. Every visual rule that matters is pinned by a browser test in `tools/qa`.

**Tech Stack:** Node build script, vanilla JS/CSS, Playwright + Chromium tests, axe-core 4.10.2 (vendored).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-website-redesign-v3-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Keep the business name, logo, colours (navy `#0A2D5C`, teal `#2FA4A6`, sky `#6FC3E0`, sand `#EFD9AE`, ivory `#F7F3EA`) and the two font families (Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans).
- These come from `js/config.js` and functions in `tools/build.mjs`, and none are hard-coded: services, prices, discounts, tax, policies and contact details. No new rates; no change to discount stacking (the first visit gets the larger of the founding and plan discounts, never both).
- Must not be added:
  - claims of insurance, bonding, screening, certifications, reviews, ratings, customer counts or awards;
  - new services;
  - generated or stock people.
- Room photos stay the disclosed illustrations, and the owner portrait stays real.
- Request wording stays everywhere: "request", "not confirmed yet", "estimate", "Mann confirms".
- Booking fields, payloads, endpoints, spam traps and success rules are unchanged.
- URLs, titles, descriptions, canonicals, structured data and the sitemap are unchanged.
- Every existing behaviour test keeps passing; design tests change only where this spec changes the rule. `node tools/qa/perf.mjs`: LCP 2.2s or less, CLS 0.05 or less. Baseline on identical code: Home 2.07s, Service 1.94s, Pricing 2.06s, Area 1.92s, Booking 1.96s, CLS 0.
- `node tools/build.mjs` regenerates pages; generated HTML is committed with its change.
- Work on branch `ccr-395dcbdf-yvcyfr`. Push it; **do not merge or publish.**

## Review Focus

1. **The phone menu while open.** Tab must never reach the page behind it, and closing it must never strand focus. Task 4 test `menu keeps focus in the header and menu, and Escape returns it`.
2. **Pricing examples drifting from the calculator.** The worked examples must equal what the booking form shows for the same inputs. Task 3 test `pricing examples match the booking calculator`.
3. **Photo service cards at in-between widths** (768 and 1024) must not squeeze names or prices or push the page sideways. Task 2 test `home services: four photo cards…` and Task 4's 1024 layout width.
4. **Dark mode on the new pieces** (plan strip, price explainer, quote-path row, flat cards) must keep contrast. The existing `contrast holds in both themes` test runs on home, pricing and booking after Tasks 2–3.
5. **Removing the founding panel** must not remove the offer from the price box, the top bar or the service prices while the offer is active. Task 2 test `the founding offer appears in the price box and service prices, not as a separate panel`.

## File Structure

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `css/site.css` | Tokens, components (Task 1); homepage pieces (Task 2); price explainer (Task 3); fixes (Task 5) |
| `tools/build.mjs` | Section heads, hero, home services, quote-path row, standard band, plan strip, founding panel removed (Task 2); `priceExplainer()` on pricing (Task 3) |
| `js/site.js` | Mobile-menu focus and `inert` (Task 4) |
| `tools/qa/design.test.mjs` | v3 rules replace v2 ones (Tasks 1–2) |
| `tools/qa/home.test.mjs` | New homepage composition tests (Task 2) |
| `tools/qa/pricebox.test.mjs` | Pricing-example consistency (Task 3) |
| `tools/qa/a11y.test.mjs`, `tools/qa/layout.test.mjs` | Menu focus test; 1024px width (Task 4) |
| `README.md`, `docs/design-notes.md` | Design system notes and image sources (Task 6) |

### Task 1: v3 tokens and shared components

**Files:** Modify `css/site.css`, `tools/build.mjs` (remove `section-head-center`), `tools/qa/design.test.mjs`.

**Interfaces — produces:**
- **Tokens:** `--card-radius: 14px`, `--band-radius: 20px`, `--field-radius: 12px`.
- **Cards** (`.svc-card`, `.district`, `.guide-card`, `.plan`, `.incl-card` and similar): `box-shadow: none`, a 1px `--card-line` border, and no `transform` on hover. On fine-pointer hover with motion allowed, `border-color: var(--field)`.
- **Eyebrows** `.label`, `.kicker`:
  - `background: transparent`, no `::before` dot, DM Sans `0.86rem`, weight 700, colour `--teal-ink`;
  - on navy (`.label-light` and labels inside `.standard` or `.final-cta`), `#8FE0DD`.
- **Section heads:** `.section-head` is left-aligned. From 60em, `.section-head-split` puts the heading left and the intro or link right.
- **Heroes:** `.hero` has `background: var(--page-bg)`, with no `background-image`.
- **FAQ:** `.faq-list > details` has no radius, transparent background, no border except `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-line)`. The list has `border-top: 1px solid var(--card-line)`.

### Task 2: Homepage recomposition

**Files:** Modify `tools/build.mjs` (home body, `serviceCards` or a new `homeServices(L)`, `plansGrid()`, standard band), `css/site.css`. Create `tools/qa/home.test.mjs`. Modify `tools/qa/design.test.mjs` (retire `photo behind the price box on desktop only`, `section heads are centred…`, `service cards sit three to a row on desktop`).

**Interfaces — produces:**

1. **Hero:**
   - `.hero-home` has no `.hero-photo` or decorative `img`; the founder avatar is the only image.
   - `.hero-copy .kicker` reads `House cleaning in North York & Scarborough`.
   - `.hero-cta` holds exactly one `.btn-primary` ("Book your clean", `href` `book/`) and one `.text-link` "How it works" (`#how`). The WhatsApp button only appears when `B.whatsapp` is set (it is empty).
2. **`homeServices(L)`:** `<ul class="svc-feature">` with four `<li class="svc-feature-card">` for `regular`, `deep`, `move` and `detail`, in that order. Each holds:
   - `photo(L, <room>, { sizes: "(min-width: 64em) 300px, (min-width: 37.5em) 45vw, 92vw" })`, lazy. Rooms: regular → `living-room`, deep → `kitchen`, move → `entryway`, detail → `bathroom`.
   - An `h3` with the service name.
   - `<p class="svc-best">Best for: <idealFor[0] in lower case after the first word></p>`.
   - `<p class="svc-price">From <b>$base</b> <span class="svc-first">$X first visit</span></p>`, with the first-visit span only while the founding offer is active.
   - `<a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="book/?s=<key>">Book</a>`.
   - `<a class="text-link" href="services/<slug>/#included">What's included</a>`.
3. **Grid:** `.svc-feature` is one column, two from 37.5em, four from 64em.
4. **Quote-path row:** `<div class="svc-paths"><p>Not a regular home?</p>` followed by three links:
   - Residence Care → `services/residence-care/`, "Larger homes and fine finishes";
   - Small Office Cleaning → `services/office-cleaning/`, "Offices, clinics and studios";
   - For realtors → `realtors/`, "Listings and rentals".
5. **How it works:** `ol.steps-3` items have no border, background or shadow; a hairline rule sits above the row.
6. **Standard band:** `.standard` keeps the five-step list and the guarantee text. There is no `.standard-photo` and no guarantee element with its own background. The guarantee sits in `.standard-guarantee`, with `border-top` (narrow screens) or `border-left` (from 60em) at `rgba(255,255,255,.18)`.
7. **Plan strip:** `plansGrid()` renders `.plan-strip` with four `.plan` cells. Cells have no individual border or radius, and are divided by `--card-line`. The strip has one border and `--card-radius`. The "Most popular" flag stays.
8. **Founding panel:** `foundingCard(L)` is no longer used on the homepage.

### Task 3: How your price is worked out (pricing page)

**Files:** Modify `tools/build.mjs` (new `priceExplainer()`, inserted after the pricing hero), `css/site.css`, `tools/qa/pricebox.test.mjs`.

**Interfaces — produces:**
- `<section class="section" id="how-price">` with `h2` "How your price is worked out" and an `<ol class="price-steps">` of four items whose `h3`s are, in order:
  1. "Base price"
  2. "Extras"
  3. "One discount"
  4. "Estimate, then Mann confirms"
- Two `<figure class="price-example" data-example="a|b">` blocks with a caption starting "Example:". Lines are `<dl>` rows with `<dt>` label and `<dd data-amount>` money. Every amount is computed in the build from `price()`, `afterDiscount()`, `C.addons` and `C.frequencies`:
  - **Example A** (Regular, 2-bed 1-bath condo, every 2 weeks):
    - "Regular price" = `price("regular",2,1,"condo")`;
    - "First visit (20% founding discount)" = `afterDiscount(p, max(founding, biweekly))`;
    - "Later visits, every 2 weeks" = `afterDiscount(p, biweekly)`.
  - **Example B** (Deep, 3-bed 2-bath house, inside oven):
    - "Base price" = `price("deep",3,2,"house")`;
    - "Inside oven" = the oven add-on price;
    - "Total before discount";
    - "First visit (20% founding discount)" = `afterDiscount(total, founding)`.
- When the founding offer is off, the first-visit rows use the plan discount (A) or no discount (B), and their labels drop "founding".

  // book ?s=deep&h=house&bd=3&ba=2, postal M1P 1A1, add oven -> [data-total] "$392"
```

### Task 4: Mobile-menu focus and the 1024px width

**Files:** Modify `js/site.js` (`bindChrome` `setMenu`), `tools/qa/a11y.test.mjs`, `tools/qa/layout.test.mjs` (widths gain 1024).

**Interfaces — produces:**
- `setMenu(open, returnFocus)`. While the menu is open, `main`, `footer`, `[data-action-bar]` and `.announce` have the `inert` attribute (removed on close).
- Escape closes the menu and focuses `.menu-btn` when focus was inside the menu or on the button.
- A menu link closes the menu as today.

  // focus a menu link, press Escape -> #menu hidden, activeElement is .menu-btn, aria-expanded "false"; main has no inert attribute
```

Add `1024` to the widths in `layout.test.mjs`.
